description: Time-stretch layers (Layer > Time > Time Stretch, the Stretch column): to a percentage or a new length, holding the In point, the current time or the Out point in place; or stretch so the In or Out point lands on a time (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+, and +.). Optionally keep keyframes at their original times, or conform the source footage's frame rate instead

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

conformFrameRate.description: Instead of stretching: conform the layers' source footage to this frame rate (Interpret Footage; 0 uses the file's rate). Affects every layer using that footage

duration.description: New length between In and Out points, seconds

edge.description: Stretch so this end lands on at, keeping the other end in place

holdInPlace.description: percent and duration: which point stays put. Default in_point

keepKeyframeTimes.description: Leave keyframes at their composition times instead of stretching them with the layer

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

percent.description: Stretch factor percent (100 is normal speed, 200 half speed, negative plays backwards)

name: stretch_layers
title: Stretch Layers
